column1: # Korg TR-Rack factory PROGRAM names, banks A-D (512). Banks A and B = Trinity factory banks A/B.
# Source: TR-Rack Ctrlr panel (github.com/FRDTom/TR-Rack-Editor, Lua progNameList/progNames), hand-typed from
#   Korg's TR-Rack Voice Name List -> some OCR-style typos (e.g. "Plano" for "Piano", "Hil!" for "Hit!").
# Suffix in the panel: (S)=Single osc, (D)=Double osc, (d)=Drum program.
# Evidence A/B == Trinity factory: in user file 5 (Trinity plus/pro, user-edited) 41 of 128 bank-A
#   and 59 of 128 bank-B program names are identical at the same slot; 95 of those 100 also have the same osc mode.
# Banks C/D are TR-Rack factory data (may use TR-Rack-only multisamples 375-414); the Trinity Flash-ROM C/D
#   banks shipped empty/with other data -- do not assume equality.
# NOTE: Korg also publishes a separate "Voice Name List for V3" (scanned PDF, not transcribed); V3 preloads
#   (e.g. V3_PLOAD.PCG named in PCG Tools notes) may differ from this list, at least for the M bank.
